current_f2_observation.finding: Current main already hard-disables physical_credit and requires at least one T4 mandatory obligation for physical_completion_candidate, so the original PR415 physical-credit symptom has narrowed. The closed-world defect remains at completion status: TargetCompletionReport still evaluates only caller-supplied obligations and has no authoritative obligation-universe identity/generation/digest or expected mandatory ID set. A supplied passing subset can therefore still be COMPLETE at status scope even when required obligations are omitted outside the tuple.

observed_mechanism: Execution is requested by action_digest after Command, Action and all inputs are uploaded to content-addressable storage.
Action includes command_digest and input_root_digest; the root directory and referenced subdirectories/content blobs must be present in CAS.
ActionCache addresses ActionResult by digest of the encoded Action that produced it.
primary_sources.transferable_invariant: A result should be bound to the exact declared input/spec object whose digest names the computation, rather than merely carrying unrelated result fields.
primary_sources.non_transferable_or_caveat: This does not prove that the declared input set is complete with respect to real dependencies. If the authoritative declaration omits a required dependency, content addressing alone cannot discover it.

observed_mechanism: Condition.status is explicitly constrained to True, False or Unknown.

Condition.observedGeneration records the metadata generation on which the condition was based; the source explicitly says a condition is out of date when observedGeneration lags the current generation.
primary_sources.transferable_invariant: Completion evidence should be explicitly ternary and generation-bound so stale evidence cannot silently satisfy a current obligation universe.
primary_sources.non_transferable_or_caveat: Kubernetes conditions are not themselves a closed mandatory-condition universe. Absence of a condition does not automatically prove an expected requirement is Unknown unless another contract defines which condition types are required.

observed_mechanism: The snapshot role signs metadata describing the latest version of all targets metadata and is intended to prevent mix-and-match combinations.
Snapshot METAFILES bind metadata paths to versions and optionally lengths/hashes; update procedure increments snapshot version and signs the updated metadata.
Timestamp metadata binds snapshot metadata and is versioned/signed.
primary_sources.transferable_invariant: A manifest-like universe should have its own identity/version and deterministic integrity binding, and consumers should reject mismatched generations/digests rather than accepting a plausible subset.
primary_sources.non_transferable_or_caveat: TUF secures metadata/file selection; it does not establish runtime completion or prove every declared obligation was executed.

supported: Bind outcome to an exact declared universe/spec identity, not just to individual outcomes.
Bind evidence to the generation it observed; stale generation is not current evidence.
Use an explicit Unknown state for missing/stale required evidence.
Use deterministic digest/version identity for the declared universe and fail closed on mismatch.
not_supported_by_sources_alone: That a manifest object is sufficient if callers can mint or incompletely construct it.
That exact-set equality is always the right policy; optional/non-applicable obligations need an explicit typed policy.
That these external mechanisms grant any F2 runtime, physical-host or whole-system credit.

f2_candidate_invariant: TargetCompletionReport should consume an admitted TargetObligationManifest identity (schema + target/profile/fidelity scope + generation + canonical digest + mandatory obligation IDs and applicability policy), verify exact coverage of all applicable mandatory IDs exactly once, and materialize any missing required ID as UNKNOWN before computing COMPLETE. Report/evidence generation must match the manifest generation. Physical credit remains a separate physical-evidence gate.
counterhypothesis: The bug may persist even with a manifest if the manifest is caller-minted, stale, profile-mismatched or omits mandatory IDs. Therefore producer/admission authority for the manifest and exact target/profile/fidelity binding are part of the closure, not optional hardening.
